race.comment: Tough edition of the Geelong Classic with a host of converging form lines. ICY YOU (2) was a long neck off Ethereal Stakes winner Quick Finish two back then ran well in the Super Impose Stakes which held up well in the Caulfield Classic. Drawn wide but he can roll forward and go close. TRUE TONE (1) is the interesting one off a Warwick Farm maiden win over 1600m. Did beat Tharwa there who was a huge run in the Ethereal on Saturday. Straight to 2200m but Lane on and drawn well. MURSHIDI (7) was well backed to beat Fringilla here last time who started favourite in the Ethereal. He gets a lovely run for Shinn. Have to respect ENCHILADA (6) who destroyed them by 7 lengths at Warrnambool in fast time latest. Just not sure how far back he gets. COLD SHOWER (5) won well here over 2270m last time and will give them something to catch.
